history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's ES-FL Fix details. This function is used to fix the ES / FL movement for a selected booking, by selecting and updating the correct booking of the selected container.

search.name: Voyage
search.ui: Input Voyage, it will auto populate. The swap icon switches the field between auto populate and Select Voyage Port drop down list

search.name: From / To Date
search.ui: Input From and To date and time

search.name: Size Type
search.ui: Select Size Type from the list

search.name: Search
search.ui: At least one query field must be entered. Query the data based on the values entered in the query fields

search.name: Reset
search.ui: Clear all the query fields to query with new data

display.name: Update Gate Out / Gate In
display.ui: Select Gate Out or Gate In to choose the movement to be updated for the record

display.name: Booking No
display.ui: Booking Number of the queried booking

display.name: Container No.
display.ui: Container Number of the queried booking

display.name: Size Type
display.ui: Container Size Type of the queried booking

display.name: Gate Out Move Booking No
display.ui: Booking Number linked to the Gate Out movement

display.name: Gate Out Move Move Date
display.ui: Move Date of the Gate Out movement

display.name: Gate Out Move Container No.
display.ui: Container Number of the Gate Out movement

display.name: Gate Out Move Pickup Ref
display.ui: Pickup Reference of the Gate Out movement

display.name: Gate In Move Booking No
display.ui: Booking Number linked to the Gate In movement

display.name: Gate In Move Move Date
display.ui: Move Date of the Gate In movement

display.name: Gate In Move Container No.
display.ui: Container Number of the Gate In movement

display.name: Gate In Move Turn-In Ref
display.ui: Turn-In Reference of the Gate In movement

display.name: Submit
display.ui: After selecting Gate Out or Gate In for the record, the selected ES / FL movement will be fixed for the selected booking
